item.title: Groups sue Trump administration after changes made to Philadelphia slavery exhibit

item.title: Michigan has spent $40M trying to fix foster care. Abuse is increasing
item.description: After 18 years and at least $40 million spent on the court-monitored overhaul of Michigan’s child welfare system, abuse and neglect are on the rise in state foster care.

item.title: Proposed changes to educator sexual abuse policies likely to face pushback from teachers’ union
